channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: More dogs rescued from La Mesa hoarder placed in foster homes
item.description: The San Diego Humane Society (SDHS) announced that 29 dogs from the apartment remain in their care, with hopes to find placements.

item.title: With ‘Chucky’ Lozano on way out, where could he land and what can SDFC expect in return?
item.description: Lozano could be sent to a needy MLS club, or one that thinks he could be the missing piece for a title. Another option is an overseas transfer.

item.title: Six shows to see this week in San Diego
item.description: Whether your tastes run to blues, Americana, country, rock, or a cappella, you'll find something to satisfy your audio appetite.

item.title: Mission Times Courier: Jan. 16, 2026
item.description: Mission Times Courier’s Jan. 16–Feb. 12, 2026 issue highlights community giving at Mission Trails Regional Park, wildfire safety planning, local government actions, East County wine country, sports milestones, new California laws, neighborhood events, and voices from Allied Gardens, Del Cerro, San Carlos, and surrounding communities.

item.title: In centennial year, SD Museum of Art looks to future with design by renowned architect
item.description: The international firm, Foster + Partners, is tasked with adding a contemporary, sustainable west wing to the San Diego Museum of Art.

item.title: La Jolla Village News: Jan. 16, 2026
item.description: Large crowds drawn by King Tides damage La Jolla tide pools, raising concerns about wildlife protection and visitor behavior. This issue also covers new California laws for 2026, local sports victories, housing debates, community events, and a look back at major La Jolla stories that shaped 2025.

item.title: Beach and Bay Press: Jan. 16, 2026
item.description: A judge’s injunction halts a major accessory dwelling unit development in Pacific Beach as city review continues. This issue also reports on new California laws taking effect in 2026, a Mission Bay Polar Plunge fundraiser, bluff erosion concerns, local deportation news, housing projects to watch, and community education and sports stories.

item.title: California calls on Elon Musk’s xAI to halt creation of sexual deepfakes
item.description: Providing such imagery, the attorney general wrote, violates state laws related to public decency and a new “deepfake” pornography law.

item.title: He launched San Diego’s EMS overhaul as fire chief. Now he’s helping AMR compete for the contract.
item.description: The city could soon choose a new company to run its ambulance services. The former city official who kicked off that process is working for one of the companies that wants the job.

item.title: Trump issues second pardon for South Bay businesswoman convicted of fraud
item.description: Adriana Camberos was sentenced to a year in prison. A jury convicted her and her brother of conspiracy and fraud in 2024.
